home_club.title: Management software for padel, tennis and pickleball clubs
home_club.intro: WeLoveRacket is a digital platform that makes running a padel, tennis or pickleball club simpler and improves the experience of the people who manage it. Its main tools are:
home_club.tools_2: Players book and cancel courts on their own
home_club.tools_4: Online payments that fit your business model
home_club.tools_6: Leagues with rounds, results and standings
home_club.tools_7: Customer management and a virtual wallet
home_club.all_in_one: All in one intuitive platform, built to bring sports clubs online.
home_club.simplify: Run your club more easily with a simple, intuitive interface
home_club.boost: Grow your club with tools that improve communication, streamline your website, speed up payments and help your players progress, all in one platform.
home_club.specialists: We specialise in the needs and management of racket sports.
home_club.bookings_text: With WeLoveRacket you can create different kinds of bookings. Open the calendar, pick the day and the time slot, and type the player's name. If they are already in our system, their name and phone number are filled in for you. There are several booking types:
home_club.bookings_1: Standard: one specific day and time.
home_club.bookings_2: Recurring: the same weekday and time, until the week you choose.
home_club.bookings_3: Lesson: for a coach to teach.
home_club.bookings_4: Online: made by a player on the website.
home_club.bookings_colors: Each booking type has its own colour: blue for standard, red for recurring, yellow for lessons and lilac for bookings made by players.
home_club.tournaments_text: After all, what would a club be without a bit of competition? You can create as many tournaments as you like, completely free. Create the tournament and its categories. Once registration closes, and depending on the number of pairs, each category can use one of these formats:
home_club.tournaments_4: Two groups followed by playoffs (semi-final and final).
home_club.leagues_text: Not everyone likes tournaments, and weekends are busy. That is why WeLoveRacket also lets you create leagues for your club. As with tournaments, you set up the categories and choose whether there are home and away rounds. Once it is created, you get:
home_club.leagues_1: The rounds of each category, with the approximate date they should be played.
home_club.leagues_3: Standings with points, matches played, won and lost, sets and games.
home_club.leagues_4: Statistics and results for each pair.
home_club.leagues_results: You just enter the match results; WeLoveRacket takes care of everything else.
home_club.wallet_text: To build loyalty, you get a top-up virtual wallet. You can add an extra 10, 15 or 20% to what the customer pays, so they are keen to spend and come back to your club. Then you charge them from the wallet. Both the player and the club can see a breakdown of what was spent at the club: courts, balls, drinks...
home_club.testimonials_text: WeLoveRacket helps padel, tennis and pickleball clubs manage bookings, leagues, tournaments and members in a much faster, simpler and more professional way.
home_club.testimonial_1: “WeLoveRacket has helped us a lot to organise bookings, leagues and tournaments. Everything is now faster, easier and more professional.”
home_club.testimonial_2: “We used to handle a lot through WhatsApp. Now players book online and we save a huge amount of time.”
home_club.testimonial_3: “The platform is very easy to use. We can create tournaments, keep track of members and handle payments in one place.”
home_club.testimonial_4: “We love that it is built specifically for padel, tennis and pickleball clubs. The support is excellent.”

faq.club_a1: Right now it is a web app that works on any device. The iOS and Android app is coming very soon.
faq.club_a2: We are approachable and we adapt to your needs. If you want a feature we do not have yet, just ask. We are like your local shop compared with a big supermarket.
faq.club_a3: Clubs get a 6-week free trial. After that, the price depends on how many courts your club has: between €29.90 and €49.90 a month.
faq.club_a4: You do not need to give any bank details during the 6-week trial. Afterwards, you pay with the payment method you prefer.
faq.club_a5: Not at all. You can delete your account and leave whenever you want. Although once you start with us, you will not want any other app.
faq.club_a6: We love sport and want to make a living from it. We think about what clubs need and we do not like the abuses of other platforms. Try WeLoveRacket for 6 weeks and then stay with us for a fair price.
faq.player_q1: I'm a player. Is it free?
faq.player_a1: It is completely free for players. Once you sign up, you can see the results of your league and tournament matches and your virtual wallet balance.
faq.player_a2: Yes, as long as the club uses WeLoveRacket and has online booking turned on.

about.title: We help sports clubs run better
about.intro: At WeLoveRacket we help padel, tennis and pickleball clubs bring their day-to-day online with a simple, friendly platform built to save time.
about.who_1: We are a team passionate about sport and technology. We build digital tools so clubs can manage bookings, players, leagues, tournaments, virtual wallets and online payments in one place.
about.who_2: Our goal is for any club, big or small, to offer its players a modern experience without technical hassle.
about.mission: To make running a sports club easier, faster and more accessible for every club.
about.value_1: We listen to every club and adapt the platform to its real needs.
about.value_2: We design tools that are easy to use for clubs and players.
about.value_3: We keep improving to offer a modern, complete solution.
about.bio_ceo: Passionate about padel, sports management and technology for clubs.
about.bio_pm: Coordinates projects and teams so work is delivered on time, keeping communication smooth between clients and development.
about.bio_product: Works on improving the experience of clubs and players on the platform.
about.bio_dev: Builds new features: online bookings, leagues, tournaments and payments.
about.bio_marketing: Designs communication and growth strategies to raise the platform's profile and attract new clubs.
